OpenCompany · new client · design mockups · GIN-1872

Every page of the new client, filled in

46 full-screen mockups of the Vue 3 + Reka UI client for the fictional company Acme, viewed by Rutger. Each one shows the 260px rail, the main pane and the context pane with realistic content, and ends with a notes strip that cites the doc section it implements. They follow the locked direction: Home as the attention page, one rail, three panes, flat Spaces with six tools, gating by reversibility, and Space-level access. Static design artifacts only; nothing here is implemented.

Team presetAgents: Ada 🖥 · Bram 🖥 · Cleo · FinnPeople: Rutger · Sanne · JonasSpaces: Sales · Engineering · OperationsExploration pages are not locked
ThemeThe choice carries over to every mockup.

Open questions 31

Where the docs are silent, the mockups make a choice and list it here for a decision.

  1. Product name in the UIThe mockups show only the workspace (Acme). Onboarding, public forms (“Powered by …”) and the workspace address need a decision on OpenCompany versus the pending rename. onboarding-workspace, form-public
  2. Where the Make view livesShown as a “Make” section in Home's context pane. The doc lists Home results filter, user menu or Team profile as candidates. home
  3. Default context-pane tab in an agent DMRun, Computer, object or Details: which opens first while a computer agent works. Shown: Computer. dm-agent
  4. Exception scopes in Phase 1The approval cards show the full menu (once, this run, this task, time-limited, always). The messenger doc proposes only “once” plus per-target “always” in Phase 1. approval-batch, dm-agent
  5. What each autonomy position bundlesAsk first · Balanced · Autopilot per preset is still undefined; the slider shows the Team cap marker but not the bundle contents. agent-profile, admin-governance
  6. Requesting a computer for a VFS-only agentShown: the manager requests it and the request lands on admins' Home as a governance card. Cleo, VFS-only by admin choice, gets a plain statement and no button. agent-profile-vfs, empty-states
  7. Run activity visible to non-owners in channelsShown: a one-line summary with full activity one click away; approvals render as “waiting for Sanne”. channel
  8. Business-rule overrideMay an admin outside the rule's role (for example sales lead) override a field-level approval rule? Shown: no. approval-field-rule
  9. Takeover on mobileIn-app mobile web takeover or a signed hand-off link; and whether mobile-web push ships before native apps. takeover, mobile
  10. ⌘K prefixesShown: > commands, @ agents and people, # records. No doc fixes them. palette
  11. Where skills liveNo rail slot exists for skills. Shown: the catalog under Admin → Skills & plugins, per-agent grants on the agent profile, and $ invocation in chat. Also open: per-Space skills or workspace-wide only. admin-skills, agent-profile
  12. The <code>$</code> prefix and agent-drafted skills$ comes from the older skill-system plan, which the direction partly supersedes. Shown: agents draft skills privately and the owner or an admin publishes each digest. Can a draft be shared with the requesting human before publishing? skill-invoke
  13. Explaining hybrid search rankingShown: a “matched on” line per result; archived items are hidden by default. search
  14. Guests in the directoryWhether single-object guests appear in Team. Shown: an admin-only Guests filter; guest shares default to comment access with a required end date. team, admin-members
  15. What a Space's landing page showsProposed: the six tools with counts, the review queue (owner, status, review date), activity, the policy summary and a Space-scoped agent panel. space-overview
  16. Triage auto-acceptWhich labels count as low-risk, and whether auto-accept is a Space policy or a routine setting. issues-list
  17. Issues delegated to a paused agentShown: they stay assigned, marked paused, with a reassign shortcut; an outside-agent run already launched continues. Also open: is close-on-merge a Space policy, a routine or a per-issue toggle (shown as a toggle)? issue-detail, issues-board
  18. Stale presence and stale proposalsThe presence timeout value, and whether a stale change-set proposal can still be applied. table-review
  19. Relations to app recordsWhether a Table's Relation column to CRM records shows their fields inline or only a link. table-grid
  20. Who accepts doc suggestionsShown: the doc owner or an admin. The collaboration engine and canonical format are still open in the UI doc. doc-editor
  21. Drive revert versus change setsReverting an agent's Drive edit restores a Drive revision; partial reverts and Drive-side edits after the run are unspecified. files-drive
  22. Artifact stale thresholdShown: 30 days without a view flags an artifact as stale. No default in the docs. artifact-page
  23. Team-owned routinesWhose access applies (last enabler or a named owner) for a routine owned by a team. routine-detail
  24. Agent reply address in a shared inboxMay an agent reply to a shared-inbox thread from its own address instead of sales@? mail
  25. Admin grant matrixIs the per-agent connection grant matrix in Admin editable, or a read-only view of the agent profiles? admin-connections
  26. Audit export on TeamExport is described for Company; shown disabled on Team. Also: when downloads count as “bulk” (shown: 50 objects). admin-audit, admin-export
  27. Sandbox “none” on TeamShown: Team may keep the host but its computer capability is blocked until a sandbox is set. admin-hosts
  28. Preset recommendation in onboardingShown: Team is pre-selected when teammates were invited in step 1, otherwise Personal. With no computer provider, the attach card says “set up later” instead of hiding. onboarding-preset, onboarding-agent
  29. Coding mode triggers and stickinessExploration. Which signals switch it on (repo or file reference, diff, stack trace, coding run) and whether the mode sticks per thread, person or agent. explore-coding-mode
  30. Master versus named teammatesExploration. Is a Master a new kind of agent above Ada and Bram, a renamed personal agent, or a replacement? Where does it sit in the one rail? explore-master-minions
  31. Who may inspect a raw sessionExploration. Proposed: the on-behalf-of human, the agent's manager and admins; debug and read-only. explore-session-inspect
